screenshot_protocol.name: Value Matrix Visual Surface Capture Protocol
screenshot_protocol.runner: Pinned Playwright Chromium runner with repository-local fixtures; no candidate source execution is implied by this contract

determinism.animations: disabled for baseline; reduced-motion capture repeated

capture_steps: Resolve one surface recipe and one declared reuse shape; record repository_or_source_id, surface_id, recipe_id, and fixture_hash.
Launch the pinned runner against the approved fixture boundary and record browser_hash, commit_or_snapshot_id, locale, timezone, DPR, and mode.
Capture each viewport in the viewport matrix for both modes and every declared state; do not substitute a hero-only screenshot.
Run the interaction probes and keyboard path; capture focus-visible, disabled, selected, validation/error, and denial evidence where the surface supports them.
Capture screenshot PNG, accessibility tree or ARIA snapshot, DOM role contract, and computed-style digest for every tuple.
Hash screenshot_sha256, aria_snapshot_sha256, computed_style_digest, and dom_contract_digest; retain raw signals with sample_count and evidence_refs.
Normalize each dimension to score_0_100, aggregate repeated captures by median plus worst critical finding, and calculate confidence_0_1.
Apply the product-surface gate only to product_surface, surface_recipe, embedded_module, transplanted_subsystem, and intact_service records.
For engine, engine_capability, connector_engine, pattern_reference, and generated_pattern_reference, emit NOT_APPLICABLE for UI quality and continue non-UI Value Matrix gates.

value_matrix_visual_scoring.purpose: Automated repository Value Matrix evidence for user-visible product-surface reuse; engines and pattern references are not penalized for lacking a UI.

aggregation.overall: sum(score_0_100 * weight / 100), using normalized score for donor_chrome_removal_burden
aggregation.surface: median repeated captures plus worst critical finding
aggregation.repository: median representative product surfaces; polished hero cannot hide failed form/table/workflow
aggregation.confidence: sample_count and confidence_0_1 required per dimension

product_surface_reuse.failure_action: retain capability evidence and choose a priced service/adapter/pattern/reimplementation transition

positive_anchors.name: AFFiNE
positive_anchors.observed_reuse_shape: complete client fork framed as Docs module

positive_anchors.name: Twenty
positive_anchors.observed_reuse_shape: intact application/runtime with dedicated data owner and route lenses

positive_anchors.name: Chatwoot
positive_anchors.observed_reuse_shape: contained conversation service with adapter boundary

positive_anchors.name: Plane
positive_anchors.observed_reuse_shape: native/transplanted host runtime with outer launcher substitution and contextual chrome preserved

calibration.rule: Positive anchors establish a reference band, not a free pass; score identical surface/state/viewport/mode tuples and retain null vectors until capture.
calibration.minimum_capture_unit: anchor + representative surface + viewport + mode + state + fixture hash
